backend_framework.value: FastAPI 0.115 on Python 3.12 with async route handlers and Uvicorn ASGI server.

llm_architecture.value: Decoupled LLM abstraction using the Factory and Strategy patterns in backend/llm/factory.py.

supported_llm_providers.value: Local Nemotron (via llama-server port 8081), Groq (qwen3.8-27b), and Google AI Studio Gemini (gemini-3.8-flash).

file_access_security.value: ProjectFileManager enforces strict path traversal protection and automatically blocks sensitive files (.env) and binary files.

vector_embeddings.value: 256-dimensional SubwordSemanticEmbedder with L2 normalization and cosine similarity calculation.

rag_pipeline.value: In-memory ProjectRAGIndex with sliding window chunking (35 lines, 8 line overlap) injecting code chunks into prompts.

code_formatting.value: Use Black and Ruff with 88-character max line length.

decisions.title: Adopt Strategy & Factory Patterns for Multi-LLM Support
decisions.description: All LLM integrations implement BaseLLMProvider so chat endpoints remain provider-agnostic.
decisions.rationale: Allows switching between local offline models (Nemotron) and cloud APIs (Groq, Gemini) with zero code changes.

decisions.title: Adopt In-Memory Vector Index for Phase 12
decisions.description: Built custom ProjectRAGIndex with cosine similarity and sliding window chunking.
decisions.rationale: Keeps learning curve gentle and avoids heavy vector DB daemon dependencies for local dev.
